Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly updated the final understanding by attributing Queen Silvia of Sweden as the mother of Prince Nicolas, Duke of Ångermanland. This error occurred due to interpreting the source inaccurately and not properly verifying the familial relationship stated in the Kungahuset citation. Despite retrieving correct information (Princess Madeleine being referred to as the mother in the sourced article), the Planner failed to include this in the final decision, misassigning Queen Silvia as the mother. This demonstrates inadequate verification and misinterpretation of the data provided.
